scope: The method replay fixes chunk contents, observed P admissions, P and D routes, natural output counts, and application dependencies. The serial P frontier uses dispatch/ready overlaps on one host. D models either retain observed downstream phases or replay calibrated batch occupancy. Zero-GET is a conditional removal of exposed same-rank synchronous service. Formal cap replays retime measured P HTTP with a 200 Gbps anchor, which includes other P costs and does not identify GET batches.
